public.text: Model B describes an independent health identifier where foundational identity is absent, unreliable, or inaccessible. It does not specify how identity assurance and duplicate risk are managed under limited evidence.
public.suggestedRevision: Require defined assurance levels, alternative evidence, provisional registration, matching review, duplicate monitoring, and later linkage without disrupting access to care.
